_comment: Settings for the copy of the application the pipeline starts to run the browser-driven suite against (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=ci). Nothing here is a secret: the identity values are placeholders that never sign anyone in, the content source is tests/FipsFrontend.Tests.StubCmsApi, and the outbound services point at that stub too. The same file serves a local run of the published output under the same environment name.
